title: Homemade Gibson Mastermix
author: Anna Behle
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.br2nm8de

steps.title: Prepare 4 mL Gibson Mastermix
steps.instruction: Combine the following reagents in a suitable tube: 2 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl, pH 7.5 (final 500 mM); 200 µL 1 M MgCl₂ (final 50 mM); 40 µL 100 mM dATP, 40 µL 100 mM dCTP, 40 µL 100 mM dGTP, 40 µL 100 mM dTTP (each final 1 mM); 200 µL 1 M DTT (final 50 mM); 200 µL 100 mM NAD⁺ (final 5 mM); and 1 g PEG‑8000 (final 25 %).

substeps.instruction: Mix the dNTPs, NAD⁺, Tris‑HCl, MgCl₂ and DTT thoroughly.
Slowly add the PEG‑8000 while vortexing or stirring until completely dissolved.
Add sterile H₂O to bring the total volume to 4 mL.

steps.title: Aliquot 5x Isothermal Buffer
steps.instruction: Dispense the prepared 5× isothermal buffer into aliquots of the desired volume (e.g., 100 µL each) and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Make Enzyme Mix for 15 µL Reactions
steps.instruction: In a clean tube combine the following to make enough for 25 reactions (15 µL each): 100 µL 5× isothermal reaction buffer (final 1× after DNA addition), 50 µL Taq DNA Ligase (40 U/µL, final 4 U/µL), 2 µL T5 Exonuclease (1 U/µL, final 4 U/mL), 6.25 µL Q5 Hi‑Fi DNA Polymerase (2 U/µL, final 25 U/mL), and 216.75 µL sterile H₂O. The mixture totals 300 µL (the text also mentions 375 µL; retain both figures as reported).

steps.title: Combine Buffer and Enzymes on Ice
steps.instruction: Keep the reaction mixture on ice, gently mix the H₂O and 5× buffer, then add the enzyme cocktail prepared above and mix gently to avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Aliquot 15 µL Reaction Mixes
steps.instruction: Dispense 15 µL of the combined mixture into PCR tubes (20 tubes total), label, and store at –20 °C. These aliquots are 1.33× concentrated; when using, add 5 µL of DNA to each tube to reach a final volume of 20 µL at 1× working concentration.

steps.title: Incubate Assembly with DNA
steps.instruction: After adding DNA, incubate the Gibson assembly mixture at 50 °C for 2 hours.

steps.title: Transform Competent Cells
steps.instruction: Transform chemically competent cells with an aliquot of the assembled Gibson reaction mixture following the standard heat‑shock or electroporation protocol.
